name: pe-lp-accounting
description: End-to-end investor-side (LP) private equity accounting, reporting and IFRS compliance: document storage, capital calls, distributions, continuation vehicle elections, fund accounting and reconciliation, journal entries, NAV and performance reporting, IFRS 9 / 13 / 7 / 12 / 18 disclosures, fee and carry validation, liquidity and pacing, compliance, audit support and fund close-out.
